text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for the present 
earlier, Alv-san."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, there is one thing I'd like to ask. 
Um... why the sleep mask?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......―― ...You really don't do well with 
full moons, do you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know if it's effective. Maybe 
it's not.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You chose that way of life. Then why not 
try riding it out properly?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —! Ah, I see, so that's why...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To go out of your way to check on me... 
...You are very kind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not really. Being near you just makes me 
notice it. ...That intense—emotion.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Thank you once again for the 
present. —I will continue to stay true to 
my love."
